question: Who was the Indian captain for ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **Rohit Sharma**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__****Rohit Sharma:**

__
 
• **Rohit Sharma** was the** captain of India** in the **ICC T20 World Cup 2022. **
 
• Batsman Rohit Sharma completed 3000 T20 International runs and became the third cricketer in the world to achieve this feat.
 
• Rohit reached the 3000 run mark in a match against Namibia in the ICC men's T20 World Cup at Dubai International Cricket Stadium.
 
• Rohit Sharma is the only batsman to score five centuries in a single edition of the ICC World Cup.
 
• He achieved this milestone in the 2019 world cup.
 
• He scored centuries against South Africa, Pakistan, England Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
 
• He is the only batsman in cricket history who has scored 3 double centuries in one-day international matches.

**ICC T20 World Cup 2022:**

 
• **India squad for ICC T20 World Cup:** **Rohit Sharma (Captain),** KL Rahul (vice-captain), Virat Kohli, Suryakumar Yadav, Deepak Hooda, Rishabh Pant (wicket-keeper), Dinesh Karthik (wicket-keeper), Hardik Pandya, R. Ashwin, Yuzvendra Chahal, Axar Patel, Jasprit Bumrah, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Harshal Patel, Arshdeep Singh.
 
• The Eighth ICC Men's T20 World Cup tournament was held in 2022 at Australia.
 
• It was played from 16 October to 13 November 2022. In the final, England beat Pakistan by five wickets to win their second ICC Men's T20 World Cup title. 
 
 
• Sam Curran was named the Player of the Match and also the Player of the tournament.
